headline: A **lead** is a lie your schedule's logic is telling you.
body: Leads let a successor start before its predecessor actually finishes. DCMA's target is a flat 0% — no tolerance, unlike most of the other 13 checks. Nothing crashes when one's there. It just means the logic driving your dates isn't telling the truth anymore.

headline: Manufacturing's capital boom, **seen from the inside.**
body: Plant expansions and new equipment lines are getting funded faster than the project controls function meant to run them can scale. I watched that gap firsthand, inside a manufacturing employer riding the wave — not in an industry report.
footer: Built for whoever's holding the schedule now · ordo7.pro

headline: **17% better baseline accuracy.** Here's what that took.
body: On a $1M–$25M energy project portfolio, disciplined schedule logic and real milestone placement — not new software, not new headcount — moved baseline accuracy 17%. That discipline is the whole thesis behind Ordo7.
